_comment_: Template library.json for an αVβ3 conformer library. Replace `conformers` with your actual frame list. CV column names follow the αVβ3 domain convention; see pipelines/avb3-conformers/scripts/domain_steering.py for definitions.

cv_definitions.cv0_A: alpha_head_thigh ↔ alpha_calf domain centroid distance (Å) — α-leg extension
cv_definitions.cv1_A: beta_head_hybrid_egf1 ↔ beta_tail_egf2_3_4_btail centroid distance (Å) — β-leg extension
cv_definitions.cv2_A: alpha_head_thigh ↔ beta_head centroid distance (Å) — headpiece separation

states.EC: extended closed (CV0 > 65 Å, CV1 > 55 Å, CV2 < 40 Å)
states.EO: extended open (CV0 > 65 Å, CV1 > 55 Å, CV2 > 50 Å)
